text:
Sam (CSM): Troy, quick account check. CardinalTech reported higher token usage this month and some latency regressions after the last model patch. Renewal review is next month. Any preferences about model swaps vs routing tweaks?

Troy (CardinalTech): Were on Hosted API and we can accept model variants as long as outputs match our billing copy. Major constraint: we need a two-week A/B to present to compliance. Current short_ack traffic is ~60% of requests.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): We could route short_ack requests to redwood/assistant-lite-1.3b-q4 and add a token savings monitor. For latency, adding continuous prefix caching for repeat billing contexts should cut p50/p95. Example config:```yaml
routes:
  - match: {intent: "short_ack", tokens: "<128"}
    target: redwood/assistant-lite-1.3b-q4
inference:
  cache: {prefix_kv: true, ttl_seconds: 7200}
metrics:
  token_savings_probe: true
```

Ella (Product): Suggest a staged A/B: 10% traffic on q4 lite vs baseline for 14 days. Monitors: p50,p95,token_cost_per_1000,quality_checklist_pass_rate. Rollback if checklist pass drops >2%.

Troy (CardinalTech): 14-day A/B ok. We'll provide 10 compliance samples to validate output parity. Also want to see cost projection; if token spend drops >=18% were likely to expand committed usage.

ops-bot: Note: Hosted maintenance in us-east 1987658000; ensure A/B doesn't start during 02:00-03:00 ET.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll set up the A/B and generate a cost delta report. Quick action items: 1) create q4-lite route and A/B harness 2) run token probe 3) share compliance samples 4) schedule kickoff. Rollback CLI: `redwood ab abort --experiment cardinal-q4-lite`

Sam (CSM): I'll schedule the kickoff and include legal/compliance. Troy, can you share the 10 samples by EOD?

Troy (CardinalTech): On it. No immediate blockers. If the A/B shows stable latency and quality parity, we'll include that in the renewal pack.

Ella (Product): adding note: we should capture average response length shift and any changes in user-visible phrasing (tone). I'll add a small NLP diff metric to the quality checks.

Sam (CSM): Goals documented: reduce tokens for short_ack by ~15-25% and maintain checklist pass rate within 2%. Will add to renewal brief. :memo:
